prompts: A bright green splash of acid bursts out and disappears.
Acid sprays outward in a quick vivid green splash.
A soft lavender light drifts upward and flickers out.
A faint purple ambient glow floats up before fading.
Little star-shaped lights float upward and twinkle.
A cluster of glowing stars rises gently and flickers.
A light blue energy wave shimmers in place and fades.
A soft airy wave of blue energy glows briefly.
A loose spray of dark red blood drops falls quickly.
Crimson droplets scatter and drop after a hit.
Violet smoke billows outward and fades as it moves.
A rolling cloud of purple smoke moves quickly away.
Little chunks of debris fly out and fall to the ground.
A burst of angular rubble scatters and drops.
A gray-brown dust cloud pushes outward and fades.
Dust kicks up in a fast brown puff.
A green electric pulse flickers in one spot and fades.
A brief green surge of electricity shimmers in place.
Angular red electric lines pulse and disappear.
A jagged red lattice of electricity flickers briefly.
A thin orange crescent flashes out from an explosion.
A quick orange explosion arc bursts and fades.
An orange ring of fire flickers in place and fades.
A circular orange flame shimmers briefly.
A warm orange healing glow holds in one spot then fades.
A soft amber healing light shimmers and disappears.
Small pink hearts float upward and fade away.
A few glowing pink healing hearts rise gently.
Tiny impact sparks shoot out fast and vanish.
A quick spray of bright sparks scatters after a hit.
A magic circle appears, holds its shape, and fades.
A steady circular spell symbol glows briefly.
Bright portal rings expand outward from one point.
A glowing portal ring grows and fades near its source.
Long rain streaks fall rapidly through the air.
A steady sheet of narrow raindrops comes down fast.
Murky green rot fumes curl up and fade.
A plume of sickly green vapor rises from decay.
Dark purple shadow smoke curls upward and vanishes.
A cloud of violet-black wisps drifts up slowly.
Small water bubbles rise gently and fade.
A few clear bubbles float upward through water.
